I find few people understand friendship. Many people mistake quantity for quality. I've seen it countless times where people say they have many friends, but really mean they have zero close friends. Sadly, many don't seem to even realize it.

I have a scale of friendship. Acquaintances - Basically work or school friends. You acknowledge each other. You make the best of your proximity but that's it. You interact. You laugh. You share lunch. You may try to push the boundary and fool yourself that you're actual friends. Yet without work/school, you just don't have must invested in each other.

Friend - Someone you spend time with and share life. These people are moving through life in the same general direction as you. As soon as that changes, they're gone. Large events frequently have many of these people which causes emotional confusion with actual close friendship. They are board, you have an event, they came.The same is true for their events. They've discovered that shared boredom is frequently better than lonely boredom.

Close Friend - These people are what everyone actually seeks. They are few and far between. Most adults don't actually have a close friend, aside from potentially a spouse. If you have more than one you are blessed. If you have more than several, they are unlikely to be close friends. You're either fooling yourself or are exceptionally lucky. These people treat you like family in all regards. They are there in an emergency and actually care for your future and wellbeing.

I've seen a shocking number of people count acquaintances as friends and friends as close friends. For some reason we have a tendency to up rate the quality of our friends. It certainly doesn't help that social media has removed many from situations in which friendship and close friends can be found. So people people glob onto what they can find.

As you age, finding new friends, let alone close friends becomes exceedingly difficult. Most people after 40 rarely make new friendships and almost never close friendships. After 60, even acquaintances become rare simply because you're removed from the workforce and your world becomes much smaller.

At the end of the day, a huge number of people have fooled themselves into believing they have closer friends than they really do.
